rerun_command: pytest  (from the project root, with the project venv)

metadata.purpose: 2D mode must be unreachable, Native3D mode must be reachable

wall_in_plane_separation.wall_covers_y: wall y range [-50, 350] contains chip y range [0, 300]
wall_in_plane_separation.argument: in the z = 0 plane the wall plus the chip boundary separates the source region x <= 285 from the target region x >= 315; nothing in that plane connects them

search.heuristic: max(0, |target_pos - pos| - eps_pos)  [3D Euclidean lower bound]

no_optical_loss_model: this engine computes geometry only; no dB, no insertion loss and no crosstalk number is produced

finite_difference_cross_check.note: central difference at +-1e-3 um; agreement within the chord error 1e-3/R rad confirms the analytic tangents
